payload.title: notification-service's task event handlers insert into notification_logs outside a tenant context (new row violates row-level security policy), so TaskCreated and TaskOverdue events fail on every delivery
evidence: apps/notification-service/src/app.module.ts:324 (TaskEventHandler runs outside the event's tenant context)
payload.rule_violated: Tenant-table writes from an event handler run in the event's tenant context
payload.notes: With the DLQ grant deployed these poison messages are dead-lettered instead of looping; the handler still needs its tenant context.
narrative: Production 2026-10-26: aqua-notification logs 'new row violates row-level security policy for table "notification_logs"' every 30 s for TaskCreated and TaskOverdue of the test tenant.
